name: new_lead
description: Someone who is not yet a customer and could buy: asks about pricing, a demo, a trial, or whether the product fits their needs.

name: customer_support
description: An existing customer needs help: something is broken, a how-to question, or a data, access or integration problem.

name: billing
description: An existing customer writes about invoices, payments, refunds, card problems, plan changes or seat counts.

name: partner_vendor
description: Someone selling to us or proposing to work with us: vendors, agencies, integration partners, resellers, recruiters.

name: not_crm
description: Nothing for the CRM team: newsletters, spam, personal or internal chat, automated system notices.
